propositions: The undeclared-paths refusal message instructs to declare paths and retry, but retry fails with stale-material because widening file_impact changes the material basis hash
file_impact directly defines attestation scope and feeds four review sites, so expanding it is a material plan change that invalidates prior signature
The two gates are not contradictory; both correctly refuse, but the first message omits that re-attestation is required
The materiality test hashes the whole file_impact list wholesale, so any mutation (additive or destructive) changes the digest equally
The fix must extend the undeclared-paths message to state that declaring new paths requires running rebar review-plan before close can succeed
No behavioural change to either gate is in scope; both must continue firing under current conditions
